想怎么改？Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行: What should change? Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
一轮最多让模型连着做 {n} 步，先停在这里。要接着改就再说一句。: A round is limited to {n} model steps, so it stopped here. Send another message to keep going.
兼容 OpenAI 写法的地址，一般以 /v1 结尾: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending in /v1
去这家申请钥匙: Get an API key from this provider
想得越深越准，但更慢、更费钱；改个数量用「不思考」就够了: Deeper thinking is more accurate but slower and costs more; "Off" is enough for changing counts
网页版是浏览器直接连服务商，很多家会被浏览器的跨域限制挡住（Claude 不会）: The web version connects to the provider straight from the browser, and many providers are blocked by the browser's cross-origin rules (Claude is not). The exe and Android app don't have this problem.
钥匙只存在这台设备的这个浏览器里，只发给你选的服务商；不进配置文件、场景文件和导: The API key is stored only in this browser on this device and is sent only to the provider you chose; it never goes into config files, scene files or exported models. Any AI usage is billed to your own account.
已填：{key}（要换就重新填）: Saved: {key} (type a new one to replace it)
不需要的就空着（例如本机 Ollama）: Leave empty if not needed (e.g. local Ollama)
这家没有能用的模型。: This provider has no usable model.
钥匙不对，或者已经失效。到设置里重新填一下。: The API key is wrong or has expired. Enter it again in the settings.
这家的额度用完了，或者账户余额不足。: This provider's quota is used up, or the account balance is too low.
服务商那边太忙，或者请求太频繁被限流了。等一会儿再试。: The provider is busy or rate-limited the requests. Try again in a moment.
服务商说没有这个模型。到设置里换一个型号。: The provider says this model doesn't exist. Pick another model in the settings.
服务商拒绝了这个请求（内容审核）。换个说法，或者换一家试试。: The provider refused this request (content moderation). Try rewording it or another provider.
连不上服务商。网页版直接连常被浏览器的跨域限制挡住，请用 exe 或安卓版；也可: Couldn't reach the provider. The web version is often blocked by the browser's cross-origin rules, so use the exe or Android app; the network may also be down.
连不上服务商，检查一下网络（国外的服务可能要开代理）。: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your network (services abroad may need a proxy).
AI 助手载入失败：{message}: The AI assistant failed to load: {message}
这台设备自己记着，不进配置: Remembered on this device; not saved in configs
对话太长，这一轮发给模型时省掉了最早的几轮。要从头说，点「新对话」。: The conversation got long, so the earliest rounds were left out this time. Click "New chat" to start over.
打了 ✓ 的是已经填过钥匙的: Providers marked ✓ already have an API key
重新问这家服务商有哪些模型（换了钥匙、出了新模型时用）: Ask this provider again which models it has (after changing the key or when new models come out)
服务商没说的时候才用得上：它的列表里写了能不能看图，就照它的: Only used when the provider doesn't say; if its model list says whether a model reads images, that wins
正在问服务商有哪些模型……: Asking the provider for its models…
这个模型不会思考，这一项用不上: This model doesn't think, so this setting doesn't apply
没能从服务商取到模型列表（{why}），先用内置的预设。: Couldn't get the model list from the provider ({why}); using the built-in presets for now.
钥匙可用：从服务商取到 {n} 个模型。: The API key works: got {n} {n:model|models} from the provider.
填上钥匙后会自动从服务商取模型列表；现在列的是内置的预设。: Once you enter an API key, the model list is fetched from the provider automatically; these are the built-in presets for now.
「自定义」要先选或填一个型号。: "Custom" needs a model first: pick or type one.
三头六臂、九条尾巴的狐狸娘: A fox girl with three heads, six arms and nine tails
再加一对翅膀，腿长一点: Add a pair of wings and make the legs a bit longer
四条腿的人马，两条尾巴: A four-legged centaur with two tails
看全部对话：切换、改名、导出、删除: All chats: switch, rename, export, delete
用大白话说你想要什么样的身体，每一轮改完都能一键撤回。试试：: Describe the body you want in plain words; each round of changes can be undone with one click. Try:
撤回这一轮的改动（撤得回的话），把这句话再发一次: Undo this round's changes (if possible) and send the same message again
这一轮之后你又改过设定，或者已经撤回过了: You changed the settings after this round, or it was already undone
正在干活。现在说的话会插进去。: Working. Anything you send now is added to this round.
想补充什么？Enter 发送: Anything to add? Enter to send
「显示成人部件」开关或界面语言变了，接着说的话放进了一段新对话（旧的在对话列表里: "Show adult parts" or the interface language changed, so this continues in a new chat (the old one is in the chat list).
对话存在这台设备的这个浏览器里，最多留 {n} 段。: Chats are kept in this browser on this device, up to {n}.
还没填钥匙。在设置里填上这家的钥匙。: No API key yet. Enter this provider's key in the settings.
AI 助手：用大白话改造型: AI assistant: change the shape in plain words
打开以后顶上多一个「AI 助手」按钮，用大白话改造型。要填你自己在 DeepSe: Adds an "AI assistant" button at the top for changing the shape in plain words. It needs your own API key from a provider such as DeepSeek, Kimi or Claude, billed to your account.
在 3D 视图上把要改的地方圈出来，AI 就知道是哪个部件（先把镜头转好）: Circle what to change on the 3D view so the AI knows which part you mean (set up the camera first)
拖这里挪窗口，拖边、角改大小；双击回到原来的位置: Drag here to move the window, drag an edge or corner to resize; double-click to put it back
在 3D 视图上把要改的地方圈出来，可以圈好几处。镜头要先转好再圈。Ctrl+Z: Circle what to change on the 3D view; you can circle several places. Set up the camera first. Ctrl+Z undoes a stroke, Esc cancels.
这句话没来得及发给模型，要的话再发一次。: This message didn't reach the model in time. Send it again if you still need it.
连不上服务商。这一版的 exe / 安卓版还没有 AI 助手要用的转发，很多家会: Can't reach the provider. This build of the exe / Android app doesn't have the forwarding the AI assistant needs, so many providers are blocked by cross-origin rules (Claude is not): download and install the latest installer from the project page. It could also be a network problem.
这一版的 exe / 安卓版还没有 AI 助手要用的转发：除了 Claude，很: This build of the exe / Android app doesn't have the forwarding the AI assistant needs: apart from Claude, many providers won't connect. Download and install the latest installer from the project page (the exe can also get the new installer from Check for updates).
